subject: MFA prompt or Authenticator notification not received
description: User is unable to complete sign-in because the MFA prompt, approval notification, or verification code is not received. Please investigate the authentication method, registration status, and sign-in logs.

subject: Request to reset and re-register MFA
description: Please reset the existing MFA registration and require the user to register Microsoft Authenticator or another approved authentication method again.

subject: Request to enable or enforce MFA
description: Please enable or enforce multi-factor authentication for the specified user or scope according to the approved security requirement.

subject: MFA session or repeated sign-in prompt issue
description: User is experiencing repeated MFA prompts or requires active sessions to be revoked. Please review session controls, trusted-device settings, and sign-in activity.

subject: User access blocked by Conditional Access
description: User cannot access the requested Microsoft 365 service because a Conditional Access requirement is not satisfied. Please identify the applied policy and failed control.

subject: Password reset or account unlock request
description: Please reset the password or unlock the specified account after completing the required identity verification.

subject: New user account creation and onboarding
description: Please create the new user account and configure the approved licence, mailbox, groups, and access required for onboarding.

subject: User offboarding and access removal
description: Please disable the user account and complete the approved offboarding actions, including session revocation, licence handling, mailbox/data access, and group removal.

subject: User name, email address, or alias change request
description: Please update the approved user profile, primary email address, or alias and verify the change across the required Microsoft 365 services.

subject: Microsoft 365 admin access or role request
description: Please grant, modify, or review the requested Microsoft 365 administrative role using least-privilege access and the supplied approval.

subject: Microsoft 365 licence assignment or removal
description: Please assign or remove the specified Microsoft 365 licence for the listed user and confirm service availability after the change.

subject: Microsoft 365 subscription renewal or expiry support
description: Please review the subscription renewal or expiry concern and confirm the affected SKU, quantity, renewal status, and required action.

subject: Microsoft 365 licence availability or count mismatch
description: The expected licence quantity or availability is not reflected in the admin portal. Please validate the subscription status, purchased quantity, and assigned/available counts.

subject: Microsoft 365 licence plan clarification or comparison
description: Please provide a feature and eligibility comparison for the requested Microsoft 365 plans based on the stated user and security requirements.

subject: Email not received by recipient
description: The recipient is not receiving expected email. Please investigate message trace, filtering, quarantine, transport rules, recipient configuration, and sender-domain authentication.

subject: Unable to send email or message delivery failure
description: The user cannot send email or receives a non-delivery report. Please review the error, message trace, connectors, restrictions, and recipient-domain response.

subject: Email incorrectly delivered to spam or quarantine
description: A legitimate message was filtered as spam or quarantined. Please analyse the message, detection reason, policy, sender authentication, and safe remediation.

subject: Mail flow or transport rule configuration request
description: Please create, modify, review, or troubleshoot the requested Exchange Online mail-flow rule according to the approved business condition and action.

subject: Mailbox forwarding configuration request
description: Please configure, remove, or investigate mailbox forwarding for the specified user and verify that it follows the organisation’s security policy.

subject: Outlook sign-in or connectivity issue
description: User cannot sign in to Outlook or Outlook cannot connect to the mailbox. Please investigate credentials, licence, service status, profile, and connectivity errors.

subject: Outlook synchronisation or Send/Receive issue
description: Outlook is not synchronising mailbox content or Send/Receive is delayed or failing. Please investigate profile health, cached mode, connectivity, and mailbox status.

subject: Mailbox storage or quota exceeded
description: The mailbox is approaching or has exceeded its storage quota. Please review mailbox usage, licence limits, archive availability, and approved cleanup or expansion options.

subject: Online Archive or retention configuration request
description: Please enable, configure, or troubleshoot Online Archive and retention for the specified mailbox according to the approved retention requirement.

subject: Shared mailbox access or permission request
description: Please create or configure the shared mailbox and grant the approved Full Access, Send As, or Send on Behalf permissions.

subject: Phishing or suspicious email investigation
description: A suspected phishing or malicious message was reported. Please analyse message headers, URLs, attachments, sender authentication, delivery scope, and required containment actions.

subject: Email spoofing or impersonation investigation
description: A message appears to spoof or impersonate a trusted user or domain. Please analyse authentication results, impersonation detections, and affected recipients, then apply approved remediation.

subject: Suspected compromised Microsoft 365 account
description: Suspicious account activity has been identified. Please investigate sign-ins and mailbox activity, contain access, reset credentials, revoke sessions, and review persistence mechanisms.

subject: Microsoft Defender alert or vulnerability remediation
description: A Microsoft Defender alert or vulnerability requires investigation and remediation. Please review the affected asset, evidence, severity, exposure, and recommended security action.

subject: Email protection policy configuration request
description: Please create, modify, or review the approved anti-spam, anti-phishing, Safe Links, Safe Attachments, or quarantine policy and verify the assigned scope.

subject: Intune enrolment or Microsoft Entra join issue
description: The device cannot enrol in Microsoft Intune or join Microsoft Entra ID. Please review the user licence, MDM scope, device state, enrolment restrictions, and reported error.

subject: Device showing non-compliant in Microsoft Intune
description: The managed device is marked non-compliant. Please identify the failed compliance setting, policy assignment, last check-in, and required remediation.

subject: Intune configuration policy not applying or conflicting
description: The assigned Intune configuration policy is not applying successfully or reports a conflict. Please review assignment, applicability, status details, and overlapping settings.

subject: Intune application deployment request
description: Please package, assign, or troubleshoot the requested application deployment in Microsoft Intune for the approved user or device scope.

subject: BitLocker encryption or recovery-key issue
description: The device has a BitLocker encryption, policy, or recovery-key issue. Please review encryption status, policy assignment, TPM readiness, and recovery-key escrow.

subject: USB or removable storage restriction request
description: Please configure or troubleshoot the approved Intune or Defender device-control policy for USB or removable storage access.

subject: OneDrive synchronisation issue
description: OneDrive files or folders are not synchronising correctly. Please investigate the sync client, account, storage, file restrictions, permissions, and reported error.

subject: Missing or deleted OneDrive files or folders
description: Files or folders are missing or were deleted from OneDrive. Please review recycle bins, version history, audit activity, retention, and available recovery options.

subject: OneDrive or SharePoint access and sharing request
description: Please grant, remove, or troubleshoot access to the specified OneDrive or SharePoint resource according to the approved permission level and sharing policy.

subject: SharePoint or OneDrive storage capacity issue
description: The SharePoint site or OneDrive account has a storage capacity or quota concern. Please review current usage, allocation, retention impact, and approved remediation.

subject: Microsoft Teams guest or external access request
description: Please enable, configure, or troubleshoot Teams guest or external access for the specified users or domains according to the organisation’s collaboration policy.

subject: Microsoft Teams meeting or calling issue
description: The user is experiencing a Teams meeting, audio, video, calling, or meeting-feature issue. Please investigate policy assignment, client version, device, network, and error details.

subject: Microsoft Teams team, channel, or group access request
description: Please create, grant, remove, or troubleshoot access to the specified Team, channel, or Microsoft 365 group based on the approved membership and role.

subject: Microsoft 365 domain addition or verification request
description: Please add or verify the specified domain in Microsoft 365 and provide or validate the required DNS verification record.

subject: Email DNS record configuration or validation
description: Please configure or validate the required MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, CNAME, or TXT records for Microsoft 365 email and report any conflicting values.

subject: Email mailbox migration request
description: Please assess and perform the approved mailbox migration from the source mail system or tenant to Microsoft 365, including prerequisites, user mapping, cutover, and validation.

subject: Mailbox migration failure or incremental migration issue
description: The mailbox migration or incremental pass did not complete successfully. Please review the migration batch, failed items, error details, source connectivity, and target readiness.

subject: Microsoft 365 backup or restore request
description: Please configure, run, validate, or restore the approved Microsoft 365 backup for the specified workload and recovery point.

subject: Microsoft 365 training or knowledge-transfer request
description: Please arrange or provide a knowledge-transfer session for the requested Microsoft 365 feature, administration task, or end-user workflow.

subject: General Microsoft 365 support request
description: Please review the reported Microsoft 365 request or issue, confirm the affected service and users, and provide the appropriate investigation or configuration support.
